easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Longshot.
Longshot and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Longshot trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Displacer KItten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.
